welcome.title: How are you doing lately?
welcome.body: Nine quick questions to see whether talking to someone might help. No sign-in, and nothing you enter is saved.
welcome.small: Takes about two minutes. This is a screening tool, not a diagnosis.

questions.prompt: How do you describe your gender?
questions.helper: The data this tool learned from only included these two options.

questions.error: Enter your age in years, from 16 to 60.

questions.prompt: Which faculty or course group are you in?
questions.error: Choose your faculty or course group.

questions.prompt: Which year of study are you in?

questions.helper: Pick the band that fits best.

questions.prompt: Have you sought help from a specialist, such as a counsellor or doctor?

cgpa.help: We convert 5.0-scale bands to the 4.0 scale the model learned from. This is approximate.

lower.label: Lower risk indicated
lower.title: Your answers don't point to raised risk right now
lower.message: That can change, and how you feel matters more than any score. If something feels off, reaching out is always okay.

higher.label: Higher risk indicated
higher.title: Your answers suggest it may help to talk to someone
higher.message: Lots of students feel this way, and support is available. You don't have to wait until things get worse.

disclaimer: This is a screening result, not a diagnosis.
model_note: Based on a model trained on survey responses from students in Malaysia, so it may be less accurate for you.

out_of_range.age: This tool was trained on students aged 18 to 24, so the result may be less reliable at your age.
out_of_range.year: The training data included years 1 to 4 only. If you are beyond year 4, the result may be less reliable.

sections.title: A short check-in
sections.text: This tool estimates whether your answers look more like students who reported depression in a survey. It is a screening tool and cannot diagnose anything.

sections.title: What it learned from
sections.text: 101 students at one university in Malaysia in 2020. The target was a single self-reported yes/no answer, not a validated clinical instrument. There were 35 positive responses. The model has not been validated for Nigeria.

sections.title: Who the data represents
sections.text: The training data covered ages 18 to 24 and study years 1 to 4. It included only female and male gender options, and CGPA bands on a 4.0 scale. Results may be less reliable outside that coverage.

sections.title: Your privacy
sections.text: Your answers go to the server only to produce this result, then they are discarded. Nothing is stored. There is no account and no tracking.

sections.title: What to do next
sections.text: If something feels wrong, reach out even if your result says lower risk.

javascript_required: Turn on JavaScript to use this check-in. Nothing you enter is saved.
